data.name: Life Anchor
data.description: You gain a 10-foot-radius aura that helps dying creatures cling to life. Within this aura, a dying creature (including yourself) adds %1 to its stabilization checks (in addition to any other modifiers to stabilization checks).|LifeAnchorBonus
